rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality expanded blastocyst with compact A-grade ICM, looser B-grade TE, and thinned zona, consistent with 3AB; slight overreach in suggesting early 4AB and noting debris/excluded cells that may not be clearly verifiable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior cycle history, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo and patient factors; minor uncertainty comes from image-based stage up-classification and somewhat broad outcome ranges.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET at age 33, attention to hydrosalpinx, luteal support, and avoiding routine ERA/PGT-A after limited failure; minor deviations include some nonessential lifestyle cautions and broad clinic-level estimates.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx confirmation, uterine cavity review, luteal support, and when to consider further testing.
